file_path.description: Absolute path of the file to modify

old_string.description: Exact text to replace, copied from Read output without the line-number prefix; must be unique unless replace_all is true

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence of old_string instead of requiring a unique match

description.description: A short label of what this call works on or looks for, shown to the user as its row: a noun phrase of 2 to 6 words, no leading verb
